summary: Audit of Phase 4 range edee50b..66fe1ac (tasks 4.13e Red 5db6a32, 4.13f Green aef521d+9ae4e51, plus the def8681 text-fix commit). HEAD equaled the audited head 66fe1ac at audit start (git rev-parse at 00:19 +07); the track moved to 882872e mid-audit when a parallel session landed Red 4.13g (0861c05, test-only Go-threshold cases). The audited commits are immutable ancestors, and every audited claim was verified against them. Every plan bullet of rows 4.13e/4.13f is fixed and pinned by a real test: B2 (judge-run.sh:204-214 refuses an empty quota field or a tab, exit code 5 mapped to a refusal at :217; J18/J18b/J18c fail at base per red-4.13e.txt, J18d reads the committed judges.json), B3 (review-run.sh read_message_line refuses a second line, a control character, and a line over 1000 bytes, staged checked line sent at :344 and :748; M5-M9 fail at base), B4 (symlink checks at review-run.sh:286-288 and :347-349; M8/M9), B5/R3 (8 SM4 arg-level refusal cases), C7 (judge-run.sh:619-623 judged_by holds verdict ids only; J19 discriminates because group one holds two ids and its answer drops one), R1 (P2b pins exactly 3 probe calls), N3 (real-work.ts:686 rows = outcomes.length; DS26 pushes a malformed row onto the 41-row fixture and pins footer-rows 42, failing at base), N8 (NET_SCORE_GATE = 0 at real-work.ts:47, passesNetGate at :482-484 requires net !== null && net > 0 and serves producerRow:510, gateRow:535, and pickOf:621; a null/not-rated net never passes, net 0 gives no pick per DS26 and ADV4-7; the changed '>= 20' assertions in DS12/DS13/G6/ADV4-7/ADV4-21 all still assert discriminating outcomes recorded as failing at base in red-4.13e.txt; guide.ts comment and pages/real-work.html text match). The def8681 text fixes are correct: spec D10 now names seed-messages.ts as the writer (fixes prior N6), the keys sentence now says the probe reads keys/<diff_id>.json only to choose the control diff (fixes prior N7 and review-b B1), the reseed runbook of plan rows 3.16 and 4.11 gains the message-seeding step, and row 4.10 fixes the stale sequencing (review-c R2). I reproduced the gates for the audited files: real-work 16 pass 0 fail (393 expect calls), guide 18 pass 0 fail (211), preview-gate under vitest 111 passed (111) exit 0 matching the plan row exactly, and review-run 49 pass with every 4.13e/4.13f case green (the run also executed three later Red 4.13g Go-threshold cases from the next task, G1/G2/G3, which failed as expected for unimplemented work outside this range); pgrep fake-opencode/quota-server printed nothing after each of my runs once concurrent neighbor runs ended. No A3/A4/A5 issue found: counts use labeled-integer parsing (footerNumber regex on the hook text), every deliverable check constructs the missing-deliverable fixture, and the Green log's gate claims match the reproduced exits. One new nit (N10): a NUL byte in the message line is stripped by bash command substitution before the control-character check, so it is neither refused nor shipped; impact nil. Four contract-violation arrays empty.
nonblocking_findings: N10 (nit, harness/model-guide/review-run.sh:306-309): The B3 control-character check runs on the shell variable, and bash command substitution silently drops NUL bytes, so a message line holding a NUL is not refused as 'a control character' (spec D10/task 4.13f B3) but is accepted with the NUL stripped; the byte can never reach the model, so the impact is nil and the refusal wording is breached for one byte only. Fix only if the spec sentence is meant literally: check the raw file with grep -q $'\x00' before the variable read, or reword the header to 'a control character other than NUL'.
